description: Compatibility endpoint with an x_user_stream-shaped envelope: lists every account currently tweet-monitored. Field mapping, not fabricated: x_user_id is null (this API stores no numeric Twitter user id) and is_monitor_profile is 0 (profile-change monitoring is not a capability this API has). Cost: Free per call. Docs: https://docs.twitterapis.com/docs/reference/monitoring/oapi-x-user-stream-get-user-to-monitor-tweet
name: twitter_x_user_stream_list_users
